info.title: EFDoctor
info.description: Local-first performance and safety diagnostics for EF Core codebases. Reports evidence-based findings such as SaveChanges in loops, premature materialization, and unawaited EF Core calls. Runs entirely on your machine with no network access.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Local-first performance and safety diagnostics for EF Core.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this help.
Exit codes:
0  Analysis completed with no findings.
1  Analysis completed with one or more findings.
2  Invalid input, or the target could not be analyzed.
The target must be restored before analysis. Loading it runs the project's MSBuild
logic, so analyze only repositories you trust.
